description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Uyandana & Millawa, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420222
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title registration, detailing the determination of land ownership for specific parcels in the Kurunegala District. It contains a schedule listing parcel numbers, extents, owner names, identity card numbers, nature of title, class of adjudication, and encumbrances. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" as defined for Type 4 (Land Gazettes), specifically covering land registrations and title determinations under the Registration of Title Act.
